94: Such is the proper reading: The Master said: If he said [it] at the beginning of six, etc... Why specifically from "I will not go out free"? Let him derive [it from the fact] that we require, etc... And furthermore, [the baraita states that if he said it at the end and did not say it at the beginning of six he is not pierced, as it is stated: "the slave". Is that to say he is not a slave at the end of six? And the following is its interpretation: if he said it at the beginning of six, etc... it might enter your mind [that it means] actually at the beginning of six [years of service]; let him derive [it from the fact] that we require [him to say] "I love my ... wife and my children", and at the beginning of six he does not yet have a wife and children, since [the master] has not yet given over to him a Canaanite maidservant.
